whole_file_reads.decoding: cp932; UTF8 failed, original bytes preserved

findings: Dupe DB and similarity DB fully read. These modules store externally assigned duplicate groups/pairs rather than computing content identity. DupesDB CSV load clears current state before validating input; save rewrites destination nonatomically. add_file on empty group map calls max(empty), raising ValueError. No content/stability validation in these modules.

SimilarityDB lock ordering is inverted: get_similarities holds similarities_lock then requests db_lock; add/remove hold db_lock then request similarities_lock. Concurrent operations can deadlock by source inspection, not scheduler reproduction. Manual lock release lacks try/finally; SQL errors can leave locks held. Destructor closes cursor before stopping worker and does not join.

Original clear then queue_query control reproduced AttributeError: clear replaces deque with list, while queue_query still calls appendleft. Constructor bypassed, no database/threads opened. Percent supplied to add is not updated for existing pair, find_similar returns all partners without exposing/filtering score. No code adopted.

README fully read: Python2.7/PyQt4 Danganronpa translation editor, tracks identical/similar lines and propagates edits, supports user overrides of duplicate membership. Distinguish semantic translation grouping from exact original-file identity. Extraction/build tools and copyrighted game graphics are separate, no external links or game files processed.

diffsmenu fully read. Two-folder relative-name union only for lowercase .txt; hide-identical compares loaded text, not byte streams. Saved diffs and same/missing sets cache by relative filename and reset on set_folders, without file revision validation. Missing file represented as empty ScriptFile for view, not explicit comparison error. Diff-match-patch semantic cleanup drives highlights, not candidate retrieval here. No runtime UI executed.

dir_tools fully read: game-specific directory name slicing/expansion plus Windows Explorer launch; not generic traversal. backup fully read: timestamp seconds plus suffix chooses destination, so repeated same-second runs reuse folder; mkdir failures broadly suppressed, copy2 errors propagate; no atomic snapshot or source-stability check. Main entry references backup_dir undefined here. No backup/process launch executed.

list_files fully read: recursive listdir/isfile/isdir follows symlinks without visited physical-directory set/depth/budget/cancel. Errors propagate without structured incomplete receipt. Original-function control with own temporary alias and cycle yielded six paths referencing one physical file. Generator stopped after six yields. Receipt docs/research/dedup-500/scripteditor346-traversal-control-20261102-v1.json

text_files fully read: entire UTF16 file decoded without cap/context manager/source revision validation; read errors propagate. save UTF16LE has no codec BOM; ScriptFile.pack explicitly prefixes BOM. No file writes from upstream code executed.

script_file fully read: CRLF/CR normalized to LF, unanchored regex extracts script sections. Malformed/delimiter-free content leaves empty fields without parse error. Markup stripped only in notags views. pack accesses original[-1] when translated/comments nonempty and original empty. Python2 script parsing not ported or claimed tested; source inspection only.

Bundled diff-match-patch opening260lines inspected, not whole-file credit. diff_main strips common prefix/suffix and selects containment/half-match/line-mode/bisect; line-mode explicitly permits nonminimal diff and performs semantic cleanup. Default one-second wall-clock deadline differs from exact similarity proof and offers no complete/timeout result at this entrypoint.

Original library and test compile checks under installed Python3 recorded, with no source rewrite. Python2/2.7 not on PATH. Test harness uses reload and legacy assertEquals; bundled implementation references xrange/unichr/unicode/sys.maxint/urllib Python2 APIs. No upstream unittest result claimed; compiler diagnostics in docs/research/dedup-500/scripteditor346-python-compatibility-20261102-v1.json

Diff-match-patch lines261..600 read: bidirectional Myers bisect falls back to full deletion/insertion on deadline expiry, with no timeout status in returned tuples. Line tokens are exact dictionary IDs, not probabilistic hashes; unique-line encoding uses unichr without explicit maximum/token budget. Common prefix/suffix use binary search. Half-match optimization disabled for unlimited deadline because it can produce nonoptimal diffs. Remaining implementation not yet whole-file reviewed.

Direct unmodified Python3 execution confirms diff_main fails NameError xrange on a nontrivial comparison; original test harness fails NameError reload before running tests. These establish compatibility failures for this interpreter, not algorithm correctness failures on intended Python2. No adaptation or dependency installation performed. Receipt docs/research/dedup-500/scripteditor346-python3-execution-probe-20261102-v1.json

Diff-match-patch lines601..1000 reviewed: half-match seed choices, semantic cleanup, lossless boundary scoring, efficiency cleanup and beginning merge. Cosmetic boundary scoring uses native isalnum/isspace, intentionally differs across language ports. Cleanup may replace equalities with edits, so unchanged-region length cannot be treated as calibrated similarity after cleanup.

Unmodified library methods runnable under Python3 without compatibility aliases passed961 exhaustive binary-string-pair oracle checks for prefix/suffix/overlap, plus4000 seeded edit-list reconstruction checks across merge/semantic/efficiency/lossless cleanup. Reconstruction means old/new texts preserved; does not prove minimality, quality or full diff path. Receipt docs/research/dedup-500/scripteditor346-cleanup-controls-20261102-v1.json

Diff-match-patch lines1001..1450 read, finishing merge and covering location mapping, HTML rendering, text reconstruction, diff-based Levenshtein aggregation, delta serialization and Bitap matching. diff_levenshtein sums max(insertions,deletions) between equalities for supplied edit script; global minimal distance requires an optimal script, not guaranteed after timeout/heuristics/semantic cleanup. It is not a calibrated similarity score.

Bitap objective combines normalized pattern errors with distance from requested location; default Match_Threshold0.5 and Match_Distance1000, so result is position-biased approximate substring search rather than symmetric document similarity. Pattern length guard is commented out for Python arbitrary integers: no explicit caller resource budget here. Delta decoder validates nonnegative lengths and consumed source length. HTML report escapes ampersand/angle brackets. Empty diff_xIndex can leave local x unset if called, not runtime tested.
Python2-only basestring is additionally used by patch_make overload selection. Reading extended to1450/1920lines; source still not counted whole-file, upstream suite remains unrun.

Entire1920line bundled diff-match-patch now read in bounded ranges and pinned blob reverified. Patch application deep-copies input, locates fuzzy contexts and returns per-split-patch success booleans, allowing partial application. Callers must inspect flags and verify resulting text before persistence. No filesystem writes in this module.

Patch parser accepts numeric header lengths and decodes body operations but does not verify declared lengths equal decoded operation lengths. Large patch split loop mutates list while iterating fixed xrange(len(patches)); multiple large patches require focused qualification, no failure claimed from source inspection alone. Zero Match_MaxBits skips splitting but patch_apply has separate len>Match_MaxBits branch. No production code copied; original upstream test file still only opening85lines manually read and not successfully run.

Entire869line original test file read and blob reverified. Covers diff/match/patch examples, Unicode/control characters,300line tokenization, timeout wall-clock window, fuzzy patch acceptance, splitting and nonmutation. No broad randomized independent full-distance oracle or resource/cancellation gate. Edge-exact patch test discards current return then asserts earlier results variable: stale-result assertion, source inspection.

Eleven original test methods executed successfully using AST class bodies and a harness-only assertEquals alias. Module reload preamble bypassed; original library unchanged and no Python2 library aliases supplied. This subset validates prefix/suffix/overlap/half-match, cleanup, HTML/text and diff-based distance examples, not full diff/Bitap/patch or intended Python2 runtime. Full upstream_tests_run remains false. Receipt docs/research/dedup-500/scripteditor346-original-test-subset-20261102-v1.json

Fetched109text blobs and verified immutable Git object identities; fetch manifest does not imply manual review. Whole-file count remains11. Caller search found editor user-driven group merges/removals and setup copying prebuilt similarity DB; full producer search still ongoing.

Selected editor caller ranges read. addDupe warns that both groups merge transitively, removes similarity relation before duplicate CSV save, without shared transaction across stores. removeDupe gets actual group set by reference and discards filename before DupesDB.remove_file rechecks membership; that recheck now fails, so normal <=2 group cleanup can be bypassed. This is source analysis, runtime UI not executed.

removeDupeAll converts user-defined duplicate group into all-pairs similarity100 without recomputing text scores. Thus100is also a semantic user label, not necessarily measured percentage. findInternalDupes uses group membership and basename-to-index mapping; missing referenced basename can raise KeyError. Selected-range observations do not constitute full editor audit.

Original-method in-memory control confirms editor removeDupe on a two-file group retains a singleton group: caller mutates live set before database removal, which logs missing member and returns. CSV save and similarity storage replaced by explicit stubs, no user files or database touched. Separate original DupesDB.add_file control on empty map raises ValueError max() iterable argument is empty. Receipt docs/research/dedup-500/scripteditor346-group-controls-20261102-v1.json

Config, editor entrypoint and ScriptPack fully read. Defaults point to preexisting data/dupes.csv and data/similarity-db.sql, not rebuilt on every scan. Entrypoint checks path presence before loading UI, not CSV/schema/content freshness; initial logging opens relative data/debug.log before configuration checks. Wizard/settings then returns False and exits instead of immediate recheck.

Config loads tags/replacements/history using pickle and rewrites config plus three binary files separately without atomic transaction. This is app state persistence, not dedup engine; no files deserialized or writes executed during audit.

ScriptPack without WRD enumerates every recursively found file and passes to UTF16 ScriptFile without extension filter; with WRD uses referenced ordered text files and logs/continues missing entries. No structured complete report. Loading can generate missing decompiled Python companion as side effect. Source inspection only, editor and extraction not executed.

searchmenu fully read: regex compiled synchronously without local error/timeout handling; cancel checked only after analytics generator yields, returns accumulated matches as ordinary results without canceled/complete flag. Long single-file regex can delay cancellation. Old search_bar_old calls len on list_all_files generator and would TypeError if invoked; active caller uses new path.

script_analytics fully read: cache freshness compares only integer second mtime and size; original needs_update control misses same-size AAAA->BBBB edit with different nanosecond mtimes in same second. Receipt docs/research/dedup-500/scripteditor346-cache-stamp-control-20261102-v1.json

Analytics search iterates existing cache keys, update does not purge removed keys, search does not discover new paths unless update invoked elsewhere. Missing cached path can create ScriptData with data=None then dereference data.data fields. search convenience method calls bare search_gen rather than self.search_gen. Load broadly discards pickle errors then immediately rescans; no structured completeness proof. Source observations except explicit cache control not runtime-tested.

Twelve small support/configuration files fully read. make_unique is list(set(data)): equality-based item dedup with ordering discarded, no byte/file verification. unique_postfix probes exists and returns a path without reserving it, so concurrent creators can choose same name; Python2 xrange/sys.maxint. No output creation executed.

Extension guesser checks short leading signatures only (RIFF classified AT3, PNG first4bytes), useful game heuristic but not format validation. Default end0 with start0 yields length0 and no signature match. Nested extraction package merely reexports modules, archive implementation remains unread.

gitignore explicitly excludes tests/debug/data, so absent tests/source-generated DB must not be invented. update_ui invokes PyQt4 compilers for designer files/resources; dictionary batch pins local Windows MeCab installation path, no invocation or dependency installation performed. Console changes logger level; dialog helpers normalize selected paths to absolute or return empty on cancel; rounding helper rounds halves away from zero.

Ten remaining small files fully read, including two empty package initializers. Reference highlighter lowercases complete text before extracting .txt paths, which loses case-sensitive path spelling; lowercasing may also change character count for some Unicode. It deep-copies full reference lists per highlighted block. Reference editor then list(set) deduplicates reference names, discarding order. These are text-reference UI semantics, not filesystem equality.

Spellcheck highlighter stores errors by block and appends capacity but does not trim stale trailing blocks when document shrinks; dictionary path relative to data. No GUI/spellchecker run. Word counter removes game color/digit markup and selected punctuation, splits whitespace/dashes, and is not language segmentation or similarity. Sprite helper formats IDs only; font settings container, right-click button and terminology dialog provide no dedup algorithm.

Structurally parsed all20Designer UI XML files, one QRC resource manifest and15generated Python UI modules. Inventoried widget classes/names, actions/connections and AST classes/methods/calls. No XML/AST parse failures. This does not prove generated files match Designer source, runtime signal correctness, visual appearance or platform compatibility. Receipt docs/research/dedup-500/evidence/ThunderGemios10--The-Super-Duper-Script-Editor/ui-structure-receipt-20261102-v1.json

All35tracked standalone PNG resources individually viewed after Git identity verification: standard small toolbar/media/navigation/file/search icons and two Monokuma mascot variants. They are UI assets, not duplicate-recall fixture corpus. Archived icon collection and binary gfx bundle remain distinct unreviewed artifacts. No rendering of complete Qt application performed.

Seven supporting documents/modules fully read. Tool notices cover mixed cdrtools components, squish permissive license and pngquant dual source notices; they cannot be replaced by root GPL assumption. GIM2PNG Japanese cp932 readme describes conversion/alpha/compression and squish attribution, no dedup. Executables not run. File-order table is ISO layout weighting, not duplicate fixture corpus.

MapNames.load try surrounds creation of lazy list_all_files generator, so iteration errors occur outside handler. Clears map_names but not untranslated mapping, leaving stale original entries on reload; basename-int parsing assumes numeric text files. get_map_name selects translated/original display label only. EbootText CSV module reads/writes positional translations and encodings, not content matching. Save rewrites CSV directly. No CSV/binary edits executed.

common fully read: instantiates EditorConfig and sets logging at import. Qt text conversion normalizes NFC by default; game-scene labels derived from directory regex/name prefixes and fixed tables. No generic identity/comparison algorithm. Normalization is UI-text policy, cannot substitute for original filesystem-name equality.

progress fully read: translation completion aggregates one representative per manual duplicate group, multiplying counts by all group members even outside selected directory filter (filter check commented). All group members assumed same original length/translation state. Unique denotes files/groups, not unique characters or words. Empty denominators report100percent. This is translation progress, not recall/precision validation.

calculate_progress cancellation returns before ordinary percentage dialog, unlike search_bar partial-result behavior. Cancel check occurs only when analytics yields, not within one regex/read. list_untranslated catches parse failures, prints path and continues; despite name it prints files with nonempty translation. No UI/runtime run for these modules.
